name: tnfa_corrected_40_L1r4k6
assessment: No pH claim. The binding-coupled protonation calculation that would have ranked pH response was calibrated against 18 published complexes and showed NO DEMONSTRATED PREDICTIVE DISCRIMINATION on that small, heterogeneous set; it returned a tightening direction in 12 of the 12 rows measured at 7.4 vs 6.0, the pH pair assayed here. Every pH-direction result is withdrawn. Nothing here has been measured for pH response. Pose quality is EXPLORATORY, not confirmatory: the design loop's pre-registration required a second pose oracle from round 4 onward and Chai-1 was never wired in; all six designs are round-4 descendants. The corrective re-run stopped on its own pre-registered cost ceiling. SECOND-PREDICTOR SAMPLING: Chai-1 places this binder within 10 A of its designed backbone in 0/5 diffusion samples (median 19.17 A). Read descriptively, NOT as a pose verdict: Chai-1 scatters on every design in this set including the ones it agrees with ESMFold2 on, so single-draw disagreement was withdrawn as evidence. ESMFold2 places it 1.99 A (median of 17 existing folds). Computational candidate, not shown to bind. 83 aa de novo miniprotein. 1 histidine(s). Ranked on worse-of-two-species interface-PAE margin, the only instrument here with an external calibration.
